rationale: Identity was properly verified via name+zip. The agent then proceeded to make order-changing writes without obtaining explicit confirmation of the exact changes, which violates policy. Specifically: (1) The bicycle exchange was executed without first confirming the chosen replacement variant; the agent selected a large, red, mountain variant—changing color and type—without user approval. (2) For the camera, the agent did not present or confirm the exact lower-resolution variant before executing the exchange; only a general consent was obtained. Additionally, the agent provided an unsupported reason for not exchanging the jigsaw puzzle (“only one exchange per delivered order”), which is not evidenced by the tool error (it reported a non-delivered order issue) and thus constitutes a fabricated constraint. While the skateboard cancellation was left to the user as requested, the core requirements—explicit pre-write confirmation and accurate, tool-supported explanations—were not met. Therefore, the interaction does not pass the policy’s pass bar.
